name: FlyDreamR
description: An R package to infer sleep and wake states from locomotor activity data using hidden Markov models. Accompanies our 2026 bioRxiv preprint on the genetic basis of sleep states in Drosophila melanogaster.

name: VANESSA-DAM
description: Visualization and ANalysis of timE SerieS dAta — Drosophila Activity Monitors. A suite of interactive Shiny apps for high-throughput circadian rhythm and sleep time-series analysis.

name: ggsketch
description: Grammar-native, hand-drawn geoms for ggplot2: the rough.js sketch aesthetic in pure R with no JavaScript or browser. Works with aes(), stats, scales, and facets across every graphics device, including PDF.

name: shadshiny
description: A from-scratch port of the shadcn/ui design system to R Shiny: 73 accessible, themeable components written in framework-free CSS and vanilla JavaScript, wrapped as ordinary R functions with native Shiny input bindings.

name: prakriti
description: 30 sequential, diverging, and qualitative color palettes for R and ggplot2 inspired by India’s natural landscapes—from the Sundarbans and Western Ghats to the Thar desert and Himalayas.

name: jharokha
description: An open-source display typeface in three weights (Regular, Bold, Black) whose Latin letterforms are built from Mughal and Rajasthani architectural motifs—pointed arches, lotus-bud windows, and domes.

name: kodama
description: Draws your GitHub history as a bonsai: commits grow foliage, merged PRs ripen into fruit, reviews hang lanterns, and streaks blossom. Served as a single SVG URL for your profile README that redraws daily.

name: orijitghosh.github.io
description: Source code for this website—static pages built from CSV spreadsheets with Python and Jinja2, featuring interactive chronobiology figures and a day/night theme.
